I am Sai Niharika , an intern posted in medicine department and one of the important terms of getting the internship completion is to complete my log book with my online log of what I learn during the course of my duties.\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHere we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p2\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s2\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EThis E log book also reflects my patient-centred online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p2\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s2\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHere is the case I have seen-\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp class=\"p2\"\u003E\u003Cspan class=\"s2\"\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EA 54 year old male ,weaver by occupation,residing at nalgonda was apparently alright 8 years back. Due to financial loss and family problems,he started drinking exessively from then.On\u0026nbsp; december 9th 2019,he was admitted in hospital for seizures (diagnosed as alcohol withdrawal seizures, as he stopped drinking for 10 days)- GTCS for 2 minutes associated with uprolling of eye balls,frothing from mouth,post ictal confusion,No involuntary passage of stools,urination ,no loss of consciousness.Again 2 episodes of seizures occurred during the stay in hospital where loss of consciousness present.There,in the hospital he was also diagnosed as chronic pancreatitis, cholelithiasis,alcohol liver disease and was advised for complete abstinence from alcohol.\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EIn January 2020,he started drinking again.whenever he drinks,he takes less amount of food.During lockdown period,he stopped drinking as wine shops were closed. again started drinking when the shops opened.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EIn july 2020, he started having fever - low grade which relieves on taking medication (on and off) more during nights,not associated with chills, rigors and sweating.It is associated with dry cough- more at night,insidious in onset,progressive in nature,more on lying down position.he was also complaining of Generalised weakness from july, most of the time, confined to bed.On july 18th,he had dog bite to his right knee(had vaccination 4 doses).For these symptoms,he got COVID Ag test done in july,turned out to be negative.In september,he started having abdominal tightness(after taking spicy foods ),pedal edema - pitting type (on and off) shortness of breath, all symptoms from 1 month\u0026nbsp; for which he was referred to govt hospital where he was diagnosed as sputum positive TB and started ATT -\u0026nbsp; 3 tablets at once after break fast(now,it is his 4th day using them).H\/o loose stools from 20 days watery in consistency,non foul smelling, no mucus,2 to 3 episodes per day.not associated with pain abdomen , vomitings.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPAST HISTORY\u003Cbr\u003E\nK\/c\/o diabetes since 8 years and is on metformin 500mg and glimiperide 2 mg\u003Cbr\u003E\nK\/c\/o HTN since 3yrs and is on irregular medication(atenolol 50mg and amlodipine 5mg).\u003Cbr\u003E\nPulmonary kochs - from 3 days, he is on ATT\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EMarried, weaver by occupation\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EDiet - mixed\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ELoss of appetite,disturbed sleep due to cough.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EBowel and bladder movements- normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EHe is alcoholic from 35 years, drinks daily.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EGeneral physical examination:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EPatient is conscious,coherent,cooperative\u003Cbr\u003E\nLooks emaciated\u003Cbr\u003E\nWeight -40 kgs , abdominal girth -77cms\u003Cbr\u003E\nIcterus present.pedal edema present\u003Cbr\u003E\nNo pallor,cyanosis ,clubbing,koilonycia and lympadenopathy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003E\n\n\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003EVitals:\u003Cbr\u003E\nTemp min\u003Cbr\u003E\nBP\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; 130\/90 mm of hg\u003Cbr\u003E\nSpo2\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; 98% at room air\u003Cbr\u003E\nGrbs\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp; 72 mg\/dl.\u003Cbr\u003E\n\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ESYSTEMIC EXAMINATION.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cp dir=\"ltr\"\u003ECVS\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;:\u0026nbsp; S1 S2 heard, no murmurs.\u003C\/p\u003ERS\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; :\u0026nbsp; B\/l air entry present, NVBS heard\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Inspiratory\u0026nbsp; Crepts Present in right and left mammary,infra Glomerulosclerosis\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Etiological diagnosis -\u0026nbsp; ?? Nephrotic syndrome secondary to the diabetic nephropathy or CKD.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; 2)Reasons for I) Azotemia : impaired renal excretion of urea and creatinine secondary to CKD.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;II) Anemia : decreased erythropoietin.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIII) Hypoalbunemia: capillary basement membrane and podocytes damage.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;IV)\u0026nbsp; acidosis: acidification of urine is lost.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3) Rationale : syp potchlor was given because of the hypokalemia.. Inj. NaHCO3 was given because of metabolic acidosis ..Insulin and antihypertensives are given because known case of DM and HTN. Orofer XT was given because of anemia.. Inj. Lasix was given to decrease her volume overload. Spironolactone was given it was a potassium sparing diuretic.Calcium was given to the patient\u0026nbsp; because of hypocalcemia secondary to CKD. Indications of NaHCO3:metabolic acidosis in cardiac arrest, Tricyclic antidepressants, aspirin and phenobarbitone overdoses, Hyperkalemia, Crush injuries, C\/I\u0026nbsp; in certain conditions because of adverse reactions like Hypernatremia, metabolic alkalosis, cellulitis, seizures, Tetany, sodium retention, peripheral edema.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;4) indication of dialysis in this pt: worsening of SOB secondary to metabolic acidosis with Anuria not resolved with high ceiling diuretics...Crucial factor: pt became symptomatic on 3rd day....\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; 5) Causes of same condition : primary : Minimal change disease, Focal segmental glomerulosclerosis, Membranous nephropathy.\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Secondary : DM, SLE, HIV , Viral hepatitis, malaria, amyloidosis,\u0026nbsp; Sarcoidosis, Drugs : Nsaids, gold, pencillamine Cancer: Hodgkin's and non Hodgkin's, solid tumours of GIT, RCC and lung.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E6)expected outcomes of ckd patients depend upon age,genes,associated co morbidities\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;This patients condition may deteriorate due to pleural effusion\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC5261605\/\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E7)association of ckd with hrpef\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EActivation of raas system\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAnemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHypercalcemia\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHyperphosphatemia\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUremic toxins .these critically discuss the potentail contribution to coronary dysfunction, left ventricular stiffening\u0026nbsp; and delayed left ventricular relaxation\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E8)mean Hemoglobin levels,before and after study,in rhuepo group we’re 8.85+ or - 1.01g\/do and 9.90+ or - 0.29 g\/dl,respectively(p less than 0.001) and in control group were,9.00+ or -g\/dl and 7.81 + or - g\/dl,respectively\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/pmc\/articles\/PMC4293514\/\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E9)Anaemia contributes to the impairment of health-related quality of life (HRQoL) in patients with CKD [7]. Its impact on patients’ HRQoL burden is exacerbated by reduced physical capacity and energy levels among these patients.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E10)Malnutrition is an important complication in CRI patients and ESRD patients on dialysis.
